title: `useIsWorkspaceAdmin` still reads `user.roles` — a key the v17 session payload no longer emits — so platform-admin detection (Setup/Studio visibility) silently fails wherever there is no active-member row
body:
Split out of objectstack-ai/cloud#1442's "sixth face" during triage (2026-08-20). The cloud card's open question — does console workspace-admin detection ride the removed actor face or the session face — was settled by reading the pinned framework (`907c11d2`) and objectui `origin/main`: **it rides the session face, and the session face also stopped emitting `roles` at protocol 17**, so the objectui half is a real defect of its own.

## Claim

`packages/auth/src/useIsWorkspaceAdmin.ts:42-48` decides admin (and with it Setup app + Studio visibility, App Marketplace gating, "Build an app" CTAs) from three legs:

```ts
if (isAdminRole(activeMember?.role)) return true;   // leg 1 — org member row
if (isAdminRole(user?.role)) return true;           // leg 2 — stored scalar
if (Array.isArray(user?.roles) && user!.roles!.some(isAdminRole)) return true;  // leg 3 — DEAD at v17
```

Leg 3 is dead: at the pinned framework, plugin-auth's `customSession` returns `user: { ...user, positions, isPlatformAdmin, ... }` — **`roles` is not in the payload** (ADR-0090 D3 rename; framework #6011 / PR #6048, no deprecation window on the actor face, and the session face at this pin emits `positions`-only too).

A platform admin whose adminship is derived from the `admin_full_access` permission set (seeded by `bootstrapPlatformAdmin`) — i.e. exactly the single-tenant / org-less EE deployment shape, where there is **no** `activeMember` row (leg 1) and `user.role` is deliberately no longer overwritten (leg 2; the customSession docblock: "`user.role` is NOT overwritten anymore — consumers must gate on `positions[]` / `isPlatformAdmin` (e.g. via objectui's useIsWorkspaceAdmin)") — falls through all three legs and reads as **not admin**.

## Evidence (code-level, re-runnable)

Framework at the pinned sha:

```
git grep -n "positions\|roles" 907c11d2 -- packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts   # customSession returns positions + isPlatformAdmin; no roles key
```

The pin's own tests assert the shape (`auth-manager.test.ts`, describe `customSession – derived identity and positions array`): "returns positions=[] for a regular user with no stored role" with `result.user.role` **undefined**; platform-admin promotion appends to `positions[]`.

objectui `origin/main`:

```
git grep -n "roles\|positions" origin/main -- packages/auth/src/useIsWorkspaceAdmin.ts   # reads role/roles only — never positions or isPlatformAdmin
```

Why tsc never flagged it: `packages/auth/src/types.ts` declares `roles?: string[]` **optional** on the client `AuthUser` — the same hand-copied-mirror-with-optional-key shape that hid cloud#1442's five sites.

## Not claimed

- ⛔ **No runtime reproduction.** Nobody has booted a v17 single-tenant server and watched Setup disappear for a platform admin. The dev taking this should do that first (measure, then fix): sign in as a permission-set-derived platform admin with no org membership and no stored `user.role`, and read what `useIsWorkspaceAdmin` returns.
- Multi-tenant with an active org member row (leg 1) and users with a stored `user.role` scalar (leg 2) still detect correctly; preview/no-auth mode seeds an admin and is unaffected. The blast radius is the permission-set-derived-admin path.

## Fix shape (not prescribed in detail)

Read the spelling the surface publishes: `user.positions` and/or the derived `user.isPlatformAdmin` alias. ⛔ Not `roles ?? positions` dual-spelling in reverse — `positions` is the one published spelling (the framework declaration bans resurrecting `roles` as a fallback; see cloud#1442's quoted ruling). Consider whether the dead `roles?: string[]` mirror key on the client `AuthUser` should be retired in the same pass, and whether `useIsWorkspaceAdmin`'s docblock ("The top-level `user.role` / `user.roles` from the session") needs the same correction. `apps/console/.../HomePage.tsx:82`'s comment "useIsWorkspaceAdmin reads ROLES" goes stale with the fix too.

## Refs

- objectstack-ai/cloud#1442 (the sibling actor-face defect: five service-ai read sites; its verification comment carries the three commands that led here)
- framework #6011 / PR #6048, ADR-0090 D3 (`roles` → `positions`)
- framework #5613 (the "one-window dual-emit" caveat on the session face — at pin `907c11d2` that window is closed; the emission is positions-only, per the pin's own tests)
